title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's AP-226 exam
question: You're deploying a new social media listening tool for proactive customer engagement. Which cut-over requirement helps prevent unnecessary escalation and prioritize genuine concerns?
option_A: Defining clear criteria for identifying escalable issues and sentiment analysis within social media conversations.
option_B: Configuring automated notifications and alerts for high-priority mentions and potentially escalating trends.
option_C: Training agents on using the social media listening tool to effectively engage with customers and address concerns.
option_D: All of the above, contributing to a proactive and efficient approach to managing customer sentiment on social media.
